/discover.làm chủ tri thức – giải quyết vấn đề – k: Mastering knowledge – Solving problems – Creating impact
/discover.viện sau đại học – trường đại học văn la: The Institute of Postgraduate Education at Van Lang University aims to build a modern environment for education and research, connecting academic knowledge with practice, encouraging innovation and developing highly qualified professionals in an increasingly interconnected world.
/discover.giới thiệu viện sau đại học: ABOUT THE INSTITUTE OF POSTGRADUATE EDUCATION
/discover.nơi tri thức kết nối với thực tiễn và ki: Where knowledge connects with practice and creates value
/discover.viện sau đại học – trường đại học văn la: The Institute of Postgraduate Education at Van Lang University (VGG) organizes, manages and develops master's and doctoral programs with the aim of building a modern, high-quality postgraduate education ecosystem that connects teaching, research, innovation and professional practice.
/discover.với định hướng lấy người học làm trung t: With a student-centered approach, the Institute develops advanced, interdisciplinary and applied programs while providing a flexible learning environment that supports students' professional and career development needs.
/discover.thông qua việc kết nối đội ngũ giảng viê: By bringing together faculty, researchers, experts and the business community, the Institute encourages students to develop critical thinking, independent research skills, leadership capabilities and the ability to solve real-world problems.
/discover.song song với hoạt động đào tạo, viện từ: Alongside its educational activities, the Institute is expanding domestic and international partnerships to promote applied research, knowledge transfer and innovation to develop highly qualified professionals and create lasting value for communities, businesses and society.
/discover.trở thành đơn vị đào tạo sau đại học và: To become a respected institution for postgraduate education and applied research in Asia, connecting international academic standards with the needs of businesses and society.
/discover.đến năm 2030, viện sau đại học hướng đến: By 2030, the Institute of Postgraduate Education aims to build a modern education and research ecosystem in which academic knowledge and research findings are translated into practical solutions that create a positive, lasting impact on businesses, communities and society.
/discover.đào tạo nguồn nhân lực trình độ cao, có: To develop highly qualified professionals with a leadership mindset, research capabilities, adaptability and the ability to work internationally, creating meaningful value for businesses and society.
/discover.viện thực hiện sứ mệnh thông qua việc ph: The Institute pursues this mission by developing programs grounded in practice, advancing research and innovation, and expanding domestic and international academic partnerships.
/discover.học để làm chủ tri thức – học để giải qu: Learn to master knowledge – Learn to solve problems – Learn to create impact
/discover.viện sau đại học tin rằng giá trị của gi: The Institute of Postgraduate Education believes that the value of postgraduate education extends beyond acquiring knowledge or earning a degree and also lies in mastering knowledge, applying it in practice and making meaningful contributions to society.
/discover.triết lý giáo dục được thể hiện thông qu: Our educational philosophy is reflected in three guiding principles:
/discover.phát triển nền tảng kiến thức chuyên sâu: Develop in-depth knowledge base, critical thinking, systems thinking and independent research capacity, helping students actively access, analyze and create new knowledge.
/discover.kết nối kiến thức học thuật với thực tiễ: Connect academic knowledge with practice through case studies, project-based learning and applied research, helping students identify, analyze and solve real-world problems.
/discover.khuyến khích người học chuyển hóa tri th: Encourage students to transform knowledge and research results into practical initiatives, solutions and contributions, creating positive, meaningful and sustainable values for businesses and society.
/discover.lead – kiến tạo giá trị, hướng đến sự xu: LEAD – Creating Value, Pursuing Excellence, Embracing Adaptability and Demonstrating Dedication
/discover.hệ giá trị cốt lõi lead là nền tảng định: The LEAD core values guide the Institute's academic culture, teaching, research and student services. They also reflect the qualities and capabilities that the Institute seeks to develop in students for today's professional environment.

/discover.không ngừng theo đuổi chất lượng và sự x: Continuously pursue quality and excellence in training, research and administration, aiming for advanced academic standards and the spirit of continuous improvement.
/discover.phát triển tư duy linh hoạt, khả năng đổ: Develop flexible thinking, innovation ability and adaptability to changes in science, technology and the global environment.
/discover.đề cao tinh thần trách nhiệm, sự chuyên: Uphold responsibility, professionalism and a commitment to supporting students, partners and communities throughout their learning, research and development.
/discover.lead không chỉ là hệ giá trị định hướng: LEAD guides the Institute's activities and helps shape knowledgeable, confident and responsible individuals who can make a positive impact on society.
